description: This file contains unit tests for decoding JSON health snapshot data in the OpenClaw project. It defines a struct HealthDecodeTests with test methods to validate JSON decoding functionality, including handling of clean JSON, noisy inputs, and invalid data.

classes.name: HealthDecodeTests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing methods to verify decoding of health snapshot JSON data.

methods.name: decodes clean JSON
methods.description: Tests decoding of a properly formatted JSON string representing health data.

methods.name: decodes with leading noise
methods.description: Tests decoding of JSON data that includes extraneous log information before the JSON payload.

methods.name: fails without braces
methods.description: Tests decoding failure response when the input data is not valid JSON.
